title: Beacon Category Definitions
description: Canonical category definitions. All resource needs, service_types, and populations must be drawn from these lists.

addiction.label: Addiction & Recovery
addiction.description: Substance use treatment, detox, rehab, recovery support

clothing.label: Clothing & Supplies
clothing.description: Clothes, blankets, hygiene kits, sleeping bags, shoes

community.label: Community Support
community.description: Peer groups, recovery communities, mentoring, faith communities

crisis.label: Crisis & Safety
crisis.description: Hotlines, domestic violence, suicide prevention, trafficking, emergency services

documents.label: ID & Documents
documents.description: Birth certificates, state ID, Social Security cards, legal documents

education.label: Education
education.description: GED, college, trade school, literacy, tutoring

family.label: Family & Children
family.description: Childcare, parenting, foster care, family reunification, youth services

food.label: Food & Water
food.description: Meals, food pantries, SNAP, WIC, soup kitchens, food banks

health.label: Healthcare
health.description: Medical, dental, vision, pharmacy, NEMT, immunizations

housing.label: Housing
housing.description: Transitional, permanent, Section 8, rent assistance, utility help

jobs.label: Jobs & Income
jobs.description: Job training, employment, resume help, GED, skills programs

legal.label: Legal Help
legal.description: Legal aid, expungement, court advocacy, victim rights

mental-health.label: Mental Health
mental-health.description: Counseling, therapy, psychiatric care, crisis counseling, screenings

shelter.label: Shelter & Sleep
shelter.description: Emergency shelters, overnight warming, hotel vouchers, couch programs

transportation.label: Transportation
transportation.description: Bus passes, ride programs, vehicle repair, NEMT

veterans.label: Veterans
veterans.description: VA benefits, VSOs, veteran-specific housing and employment

walk-in.label: Walk-In
walk-in.description: Show up during hours, no appointment needed

outpatient.label: Outpatient
outpatient.description: Visit during the day, go home at night

mobile.label: Mobile / Outreach
mobile.description: Comes to you — outreach van, delivery

peer-led.label: Peer-Led
peer-led.description: Run by people with lived experience

recovery.label: In Recovery
recovery.description: Must be in recovery or sober

cost.sliding-scale: Cost based on ability to pay

confidence.high: Confirmed by direct contact or recent source
confidence.medium: Inferred from website or reliable secondary source
confidence.low: Unverified, from third-party list or unclear source
